<details>
<summary>Frontend end-to-end tests — stderr excerpt</summary>

```
[WebServer] node:net:1940
[WebServer]     const ex = new UVExceptionWithHostPort(err, 'listen', address, port);
[WebServer]                ^
[WebServer] Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use 0.0.0.0:4081
[WebServer]     at Server.setupListenHandle [as _listen2] (node:net:1940:16)
[WebServer]     at listenInCluster (node:net:1997:12)
[WebServer]     code: 'EADDRINUSE', errno: -48, syscall: 'listen', address: '0.0.0.0', port: 4081
Error: Timed out waiting 120000ms from config.webServer.
npm error Lifecycle script `test:e2e` failed with error:
npm error code 1
```

Root cause: `apps/web/playwright.config.ts` hardcodes its `webServer` entries to ports `4000` (backend) and `3000` (web) and expects to spawn its own `npm run dev` in `apps/backend`. That spawned backend process reads `apps/backend/.env`, which `scripts/resolve-env.sh` has already pinned to `PORT=4081` for branch `f03` (its per-branch port-offset scheme). The spawned process therefore tries to bind `4081` while Playwright's readiness probe polls `4000`/`3000` — on this run it manifested as an immediate `EADDRINUSE` on `4081` (the already-running `init.sh` backend owns that port), and Playwright's probe against port `4000` never turns healthy, so the phase times out at 120s. This is a pre-existing branch/tooling mismatch between `resolve-env.sh`'s branch-offset scheme and `playwright.config.ts`'s hardcoded ports — not introduced by F03. The prior `implement-and-evaluate` run for this feature (`docs/F03-video-upload/orchestration-2026-09-12T22-32-55Z.md`) already flagged the same failure and noted it predates F03, affecting F01/F02 as well.

</details>

## Abort reason

Step 5 (Quality gates) aborted the run: the contract's `## Quality gates` section is immutable and runs after bring-up + pre-flight, before any contract item executes. Gates 1–6 (Backend architecture audit, Backend tests, Backend build, Frontend lint, Frontend typecheck, Frontend unit/component tests) all passed. Gate 7, **Frontend end-to-end tests** (`npm run test:e2e --workspace apps/web`), exited `1`: Playwright's own `webServer` config hardcodes ports `4000`/`3000` and spawns `npm run dev` in `apps/backend`, but that spawned process reads `apps/backend/.env` (written by `scripts/resolve-env.sh`'s per-branch port-offset scheme) which pins `PORT=4081` for branch `f03` — collides with the already-listening `init.sh` backend on `4081` (`EADDRINUSE`), and Playwright's readiness probe against `4000` times out after 120s. Gate 8 (Frontend build) was not run. Per Step 5.4, all 11 contract items were marked `BLOCKED — run aborted at gates: Frontend end-to-end tests` and all 7 Coverage Manifest ACs were marked `⊘ undetermined` without executing Step 6. This gate failure is a pre-existing branch/tooling mismatch, not a regression introduced by F03 — the same issue was already flagged in this feature's most recent `implement-and-evaluate` orchestration journal (`docs/F03-video-upload/orchestration-2026-09-12T22-32-55Z.md`) as predating F03 and affecting F01/F02 as well. Fixing it (e.g., making `playwright.config.ts` port-aware, or aligning `resolve-env.sh`'s offset scheme with a fixed test-only port) is out of this read-only skill's scope; it is a candidate for `fix-runner` or a direct code change before the next evaluation run.
